Your post is a riddle 😵💫 "As I was going to st. Ives I met a man with seven wives..." Appreciate if you can clarify.

1. Which application did you use to move the email that disappeared. TB mobile or desktop?

2. How are emails being forwarded to Gmail. Do you have local rules on TB desktop or are they applied server side. Are the rules configured to delete emails after transmission to gmail? You say "not leaving a copy in hotmail."

Have you checked the outbox and sent mail folders on the device? You can also check Hotmail's "Recover deleted items" feature to see if the email in present there? See screen shot below.

As a side note, TB mobile doesn't have any ability to move emails directly from one account to another.

Hi Lucky67

Did you have a chance to check if the email is within the recover deleted items list on hotmail.

There's no other method to retrospectively trace the movement of emails for personal mail accounts. Gmail and Hotmail offer no audit log with these accounts.
